native_cash_series.normalization: Entire native chronological cash_account_series, no money changes.

native_fill_audit.normalization: Entire actual fill_audit ordered list; fields contain no UUID/namespace; retain all action/level/price/qty/notional/fee/liquidity/order-type and simulated submit/accept/fill times.

native_funding_cash.normalization: Actual SQLite tuples instrument/time/before/after/signed_delta sorted by these fields; omit only event UUID.

policy: Exact equality required. Any economic trace/cash/fees/funding drift HOLD; never retune replay to force outcome. Different observational frame counts/UUIDs/paths are recorded separately.
